questions.prompt: What name is given to the reactive part of an organic molecule that decides its chemical behaviour?
questions.explanation: The functional group is the reactive part of a molecule that controls how it reacts.

questions.prompt: Which of the following is a saturated hydrocarbon?
questions.explanation: Propane is an alkane with only single C-C bonds, so it is saturated; the others contain double or triple bonds.

questions.prompt: Which of the following is an acidic oxide?
questions.explanation: SO3 is a non-metal oxide and is acidic; CaO, Na2O and MgO are metal (basic) oxides.

questions.prompt: What is produced together with a salt when an acid reacts with a base?
questions.explanation: Neutralisation follows the pattern acid + base -> salt + water.

questions.prompt: In a galvanic (voltaic) cell, chemical energy is converted mainly into which form of energy?
questions.explanation: A galvanic cell turns the energy of a spontaneous chemical reaction into electrical energy, like a battery.

questions.topic: Chemistry in Industry and Environmental Pollution
questions.prompt: Discarded plastic bags and solid rubbish thrown on land mainly cause which type of pollution?
questions.explanation: Solid waste such as plastics dumped on the ground causes soil (land) pollution.

questions.prompt: How many hydrogen atoms are present in one molecule of the alkene pentene (C5)?
questions.explanation: Alkenes are CnH2n; with n = 5, H = 2 x 5 = 10, giving C5H10.

questions.prompt: Which functional group is present in a ketone such as propanone?
questions.explanation: A ketone contains the carbonyl group -CO- bonded between two carbon atoms; -CHO is an aldehyde and -COOH an acid.

questions.prompt: A compound has the molecular formula C4H6. To which homologous series does it belong?
questions.explanation: Alkynes are CnH2n-2; with n = 4, H = (2 x 4) - 2 = 6, matching C4H6.

questions.prompt: Which statement best explains why members of a homologous series have similar chemical properties?
options: They all have the same molar mass
They all contain the same functional group
They are all gases at room temperature
They all have the same number of carbon atoms
questions.explanation: Members of a homologous series share the same functional group, so they react in similar ways.

questions.prompt: Which salt is formed when hydrochloric acid reacts with potassium hydroxide?
questions.explanation: The metal K+ from the base joins the chloride from HCl: HCl + KOH -> KCl + H2O.

questions.prompt: A solution turns red litmus paper blue but leaves blue litmus unchanged. The solution is:
questions.explanation: Bases turn red litmus blue and leave blue litmus unchanged, so the solution is basic.

questions.prompt: Which of the following solutions would NOT conduct electricity?
questions.explanation: Ethanol is a molecular non-electrolyte with no free ions; acids, bases and salt solutions all contain ions and conduct.

questions.prompt: At the cathode during electrolysis, the reaction taking place is always:
questions.explanation: Reduction always occurs at the cathode (Red Cat) as cations gain electrons there.

questions.prompt: During the electrolysis of molten potassium iodide, to which electrode do the iodide ions (I-) move?
questions.explanation: Iodide ions are negative anions, so they move to the positive anode where they are oxidised.

questions.topic: Chemistry in Industry and Environmental Pollution
questions.prompt: In iron extraction, what is the main role of carbon (coke) in the blast furnace?
options: To add oxygen to the iron
To dissolve the iron in water
To remove oxygen from the iron oxide
questions.explanation: Carbon (as CO) reduces iron oxide by removing its oxygen, leaving molten iron.

questions.topic: Chemistry in Industry and Environmental Pollution
questions.prompt: Which Ethiopian industry uses cotton as its main raw material?
questions.explanation: The textile industry processes cotton into cloth; cement uses limestone, sugar uses cane, tannery uses hides.

questions.topic: Chemistry in Industry and Environmental Pollution
questions.prompt: Why is treating factory waste water before releasing it into rivers important?
options: It makes the water boil faster
It removes harmful substances that would pollute the water
It increases the amount of waste
It turns the water into an acid
questions.explanation: Treating waste water removes pollutants so they do not poison rivers and aquatic life.

questions.prompt: An alkene contains 12 hydrogen atoms in one molecule. How many carbon atoms does it have?
questions.explanation: Alkenes are CnH2n, so 2n = 12 gives n = 6 carbon atoms (C6H12).

questions.prompt: Which statement correctly compares an alkane and an alkyne with the same number of carbon atoms?
options: The alkane has fewer hydrogen atoms
The alkyne has more hydrogen atoms
The alkane has more hydrogen atoms and only single bonds
Both have exactly the same number of hydrogen atoms
questions.explanation: For the same n, an alkane (CnH2n+2) has more hydrogens and only single bonds, while an alkyne (CnH2n-2) has fewer and a triple bond.

questions.prompt: When propane (C3H8) burns completely in oxygen, which is the correctly balanced equation?
questions.explanation: 3 carbons need 3 CO2 and 8 hydrogens need 4 H2O; oxygen balances to 5 O2: C3H8 + 5O2 -> 3CO2 + 4H2O.

questions.prompt: Butane and 2-methylpropane share the molecular formula C4H10 but have different structures. They are best described as:
questions.explanation: Compounds with the same molecular formula but different arrangements of atoms are structural isomers.

questions.prompt: How many moles of hydrochloric acid (HCl) are needed to neutralise one mole of calcium hydroxide, Ca(OH)2?
questions.explanation: Ca(OH)2 has two OH- groups, so it needs 2 moles of HCl: 2HCl + Ca(OH)2 -> CaCl2 + 2H2O.

questions.prompt: Which salt is produced when zinc reacts with dilute hydrochloric acid, alongside hydrogen gas?
questions.explanation: Zn + 2HCl -> ZnCl2 + H2; a metal reacting with hydrochloric acid gives a chloride salt and hydrogen.

questions.prompt: In the salt sodium carbonate, Na2CO3, what is the charge on the carbonate ion?
questions.explanation: Two Na+ ions (total 2+) balance one carbonate ion, so the carbonate ion carries a 2- charge.

questions.prompt: When the acidic oxide sulphur trioxide (SO3) dissolves in water, which compound is formed?
questions.explanation: SO3 + H2O -> H2SO4; the acidic oxide sulphur trioxide reacts with water to form sulphuric acid.

questions.prompt: During the electrolysis of molten sodium chloride, what forms at the anode?
questions.explanation: Chloride anions move to the anode and are oxidised to chlorine gas, while sodium forms at the cathode.

questions.prompt: In a galvanic cell built from zinc and copper, where zinc is the more reactive metal, the copper electrode acts as the:
questions.explanation: The less reactive copper is the positive cathode where reduction occurs; the more reactive zinc is the negative anode.

questions.prompt: To electroplate a metal object with copper, the object being plated should be connected as the:
questions.explanation: The object to be plated is made the cathode, where copper ions are reduced and deposited onto it.

questions.prompt: In the half-reaction Al3+ + 3e- -> Al, the aluminium ion is undergoing:
questions.explanation: The Al3+ ion gains three electrons to become an atom, which is reduction (Reduction Is Gain).

questions.topic: Chemistry in Industry and Environmental Pollution
questions.prompt: A metal Y can be extracted from its ore by heating the ore with carbon. What does this tell you about metal Y?
options: Y is more reactive than carbon
Y is less reactive than carbon
questions.explanation: Carbon can only reduce the ore of a metal less reactive than itself, so Y is less reactive than carbon.

questions.prompt: Complete combustion of 4 moles of methane (CH4) produces how many moles of water?
questions.explanation: CH4 + 2O2 -> CO2 + 2H2O; each mole of methane gives 2 moles of water, so 4 moles give 8 moles.

questions.prompt: A hydrocarbon contains carbon and hydrogen in the mass ratio 12 : 2 (C = 12, H = 1) and has a molar mass of 42 g/mol. What is its molecular formula?
questions.explanation: Mass ratio 12:2 gives mole ratio C:H = 1:2, so empirical formula CH2 (mass 14); 42/14 = 3, giving C3H6.

questions.prompt: In the reaction H3PO4 + 3NaOH -> X + 3H2O, what is the salt X?
questions.explanation: All three hydrogens of phosphoric acid are replaced by sodium, giving sodium phosphate, Na3PO4.

questions.prompt: How many moles of electrons are required to deposit 3 moles of copper during electrolysis? (Cu2+ + 2e- -> Cu)
questions.explanation: Each mole of copper needs 2 moles of electrons, so 3 moles of copper need 3 x 2 = 6 moles of electrons.

questions.topic: Chemistry in Industry and Environmental Pollution
questions.prompt: In the ammonia synthesis N2 + 3H2 -> 2NH3, how many moles of nitrogen are needed to produce 6 moles of ammonia?
questions.explanation: The ratio of N2 to NH3 is 1 : 2, so 6 moles of ammonia require 6/2 = 3 moles of nitrogen.
